title: Compact Playbook: Hosted API onboarding canvas (model select, request builder, code snippets)
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Produce a compact 'playbook' screenshot set and supporting export assets for the Hosted API getting-started flow. This ticket covers design and asset handoff for three core micro-views: 1) Model Quick Compare card (compact specs and perf badges), 2) Inline Request Builder (model+prompt+params composer with live preview), and 3) SDK Snippet Carousel (language tabs + minimal copy examples). The assets will be used in the Console 'First API Call' panel, docs quickstart, and a short onboarding email. Deliverables must include annotated PNG exports, one dark-theme variant, alt-text strings, and figma export sheets grouped by screen size (desktop 1280x720 and tablet 1024x768).
acceptance_criteria: A1: Three finished screens exported as 2x PNGs (desktop and tablet) with matching dark-theme variants
A2: Figma file has named frames and an 'exports' page with assets and redlines for dev
A3: Each screen has editable text layers and copy variants for EU/EN-US localization
A4: Accessibility checks: color contrast >= 4.5:1 for primary CTA and inputs
A5: Attachments: Figma prototype link, Drive folder with exports, PR link for console copy changes
A6: Engineering sign-off in comments (render accuracy and copy parity)
